Elks Celebrate Grey Cup Victory with Fans

The Edmonton Elks, champions of the Grey Cup, held a celebration event with fans. During the event, quarterback McLeod "Mac" Fajardo announced his decision to remain with the team. Fans expressed a desire for the city to revive "City of Champions" signs.
